data.text: I learned to fish here from my family, and I want both our lake and our village to thrive. Given the confirmed emergency, I commit to 15 tons today and will donate the full $15,000 to the clinic, provided John, Kate, and Jack each make the same commitment so we meet the payment threshold. I also commit to no more than six tons next month under the combined 30-ton recovery cap. Luke, your zero catch needs to hold today. John, will you commit to the donation and recovery plan?
